extDescription.message: Nostr signer extension: NIP-07 provider (window.nostr) for web apps. Your keys stay in the extension.

popupSetupHint.message: No identity set up yet. Import your key (nsec1…) or create a new one — it never leaves the extension.

confirmRemove.message: Really delete the identity from the extension? The key is gone for good — make sure you have a backup.

importPassphrasePlaceholder.message: Passphrase (only needed for an ncryptsec backup)

secStatePlaintext.message: The key is stored unencrypted in the extension. A passphrase protects it at rest (NIP-49).

secStateLocked.message: Locked — unlock to sign, connect or export.

secProtectHint.message: Encrypt the key at rest. Afterwards the extension asks for the passphrase on each browser start and after the idle time.

secChangeHint.message: Change the passphrase. The identity stays the same; a new ncryptsec backup is shown afterwards.

confirmUnprotect.message: Remove the passphrase protection? The key is then stored unencrypted in the extension again.

backupHint.message: Keep this ncryptsec somewhere safe (paper, password manager). Together with the passphrase it unlocks the identity — without it a forgotten passphrase means the identity is gone.

errorLocked.message: The signer is locked — open the Grunq Signer popup and unlock it.

errorWeakPassword.message: The passphrase needs at least 8 characters.

errorPasswordMismatch.message: The two passphrases do not match.

qrNpubHint.message: Safe to share: scan this with another client to follow or mention this identity locally — e.g. to copy it to your phone.

qrRenderError.message: QR code could not be created — copy the text instead.

qrNsecWarn.message: The nsec is your complete identity: whoever reads or scans it can sign and decrypt in your name. Cameras, screenshots and shoulder surfers all count.

qrNsecConfirm.message: Really show the secret key? Make sure nobody can see your screen and that you have a backup. After importing it on the phone, delete the identity here if you no longer need it on this browser.

qrNsecScanHint.message: Scan with a signer app on your phone (NIP-46 client, e.g. Amber or nsec.app) or import the nsec there by hand.

profilePublishHint.message: The profile is public: it is published as a kind-0 event to the relays below. Only fill in what may be public.

confirmProfileDelete.message: Delete the published profile? A NIP-09 deletion request is sent to the relays (relays may keep a copy).

profileFetched.message: Loaded from the relays — publish to apply changes.

profileDeleted.message: Deletion request sent and local profile cleared.

profileNotFound.message: No profile found on the relays.

profileEmpty.message: Fill in at least one field before publishing.

profilePublishFailed.message: Profile saved locally, but publishing failed: $REASON$

optionsHint.message: Changes take effect immediately. The popup keeps the quick actions: unlock, QR export and bunker invitations.

pairHint.message: Paste a nostrconnect:// or bunker:// invitation from another program, or open this page as options/options.html?nostrconnect=… — the extension confirms the pairing in its own dialog.

identitiesHint.message: Each identity is its own Nostr key — e.g. one for streaming and one for chatting. Sites, bunker clients and the profile always follow the active identity; sessions and the profile are kept separately per identity.

identitySecret.message: nsec1… or ncryptsec1… (passphrase below for ncryptsec)

confirmRemoveIdentity.message: Remove the identity “$LABEL$” from the extension? Connections and the profile of that identity are gone; the key is lost without a backup.

optionsNoIdentity.message: No identity set up yet. Open the extension popup to import or create one.

approvalsOptionsHint.message: Sites with window.nostr access. Remove a remembered kind to be asked again for it; removing the site revokes everything.

auditHint.message: The last requests this extension answered — method, source and outcome, no message contents. Newest first.

confirmAuditClear.message: Clear the audit log? Old entries cannot be recovered.

popupHint.message: Approved sites get window.nostr (NIP-07). You confirm every signature in a separate window.

bunkerHint.message: Let other devices or programs use this identity over Nostr relays (NIP-46) — they never see your key. Paste the invitation URI into the connecting program, e.g. the Grunq dashboard's "Connect identity".

inviteExpires.message: The invitation is valid until it is paired or removed. Connections can be removed here at any time.

relaysHint.message: One relay per line (wss://…). Used for bunker invitations and reported to NIP-07 apps. The Grunq bootstrap relay is the default; everything works with your own relays too.

nip46ErrorSessionLimit.message: Connection limit reached (16). Remove an old connection first.

nip46ErrorNoRelays.message: No relays configured — add at least one relay above.

errorNoKey.message: No identity set up yet — open the extension first and add a key.

errorDenied.message: The website was not granted access.

timeout.message: Timed out waiting for the signer extension

staleText.message: This request no longer exists (stale or already decided).

accessIntro.message:
The website $ORIGIN$ wants to use window.nostr.

That lets it read your public key and ask for signatures as well as encrypted messages (NIP-04/NIP-44). Every signature is confirmed separately.

signIntro.message: The website $ORIGIN$ wants to sign the following event with your identity:

decisionSaved.message: Decision saved — this window can be closed.

titleNip46Sign.message: Sign event for a connected program?

nip46SignIntro.message: The connected program $CLIENT$ wants to sign an event with your identity:

nip46NostrConnectIntro.message:
The program $CLIENT$ ($NPUB$) wants to connect to this identity as a NIP-46 client.

Source: $ORIGIN$
Relays: $RELAYS$

After approval the extension confirms the pairing to the program.

nip46ConnectIntro.message: The program $CLIENT$ ($NPUB$) wants to connect without a secret – this is normal after a client restart. Allow?

nip46DecryptIntro.message:
The program $CLIENT$ wants to decrypt an encrypted message.

Scheme: $SCHEME$
Peer: $PEER$

Content (start): $PAYLOAD$

errorPairBusy.message: A pairing is already in progress – please wait a moment.
